<template>
  <el-dialog title="一键动态配置" v-model="dialogVisible" width="500px">
    <el-form label-width="100px">
      <el-form-item label="目标容器">
        <el-select v-model="selectedContainer" placeholder="请选择容器">
          <el-option
              v-for="(container, index) in containerList"
              :key="index"
              :label="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
              :value="container.name.replace(/^\//, '')"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="handleConfigure">一键配置</el-button>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取 消</el-button>
    </template>

    <!-- 用于获取容器列表 -->
    <DockerContainers ref="containersRef" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
import DockerContainers from '@/components/Container/DockerContainers.vue'

const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const selectedContainer = ref('')
const containerList = ref([])
const containersRef = ref(null)

const openDialog = async () => {
  dialogVisible.value = true
  await nextTick()
  if (containersRef.value) {
    await containersRef.value.fetchContainers()
    containerList.value = containersRef.value.containers || []
  }
}

const handleConfigure = async () => {
  if (!selectedContainer.value) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择一个容器')
    return
  }

  try {
    const res = await axios.post(`http://localhost:8081/bird/active?containerName=${selectedContainer.value}`)
    ElMessage.success('动态配置成功')
    dialogVisible.value = false
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('配置失败', err)
    ElMessage.error('配置失败')
  }
}

defineExpose({ openDialog })
</script>

<style scoped>
</style>
